Portrait Style - Dsar's 90s Anime.description:
🎨 Image Style: Dsar's 90s Anime
Bold ink, hand-painted cels and rich shadow blocks: a late-90s anime look applied to today's hero society.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Portrait Style - Dsar's 90s Anime.traitNarrativeEffects:
Dsar's 90s Anime: a hand-drawn late-twentieth-century anime cel aesthetic. Confident tapered ink contours, expressive but age-appropriate anime features, clear two- or three-tone cel shadows, hand-painted color separation and a faint analog cel texture. Rich dark values and selective hard highlights retain the chosen colors. Keep hero costumes, support gear and phones modern; period rendering does not introduce period props or retro technology. No scanlines, film damage, artificial blur or printed poster graphics.

Rendering and finish only. Preserve the selected frame, body plan, actual age, anatomy, proportions, colors, hair, eyes, outfit, pose, props, Quirk state and background. Follow the selected scene lighting; this style adds no scenery, weather, clothing, emblems, weapons, aura, companions, text, border, panel or interface. Remain unmistakably anime: no realism, semi-realism, photographic skin or three-dimensional render finish.
